title: Sync upstream main: Black & White mode, Ukrainian translation and tolerant sidecar flush
highlight: Black & White mode with film responses, colour filters, a B&W mixer and toning (toggle in the Color panel).
notes: Adds the upstream B&W mode, the Ukrainian locale and plural forms, and sidecar saves that no longer fail when the filesystem cannot flush. RapidRoom's Lightroom grayscale import now uses the native B&W mode (monochromeEnabled, monochromeMix, monochromeToning) instead of the earlier saturation and HSL approximation. The sync-flush fix is applied to RapidRoom's shared atomic writer. The relative launch-path fix landed in both trees; RapidRoom's version, which also resolves the edit-session output path, is kept. The B&W mode is off by default, so existing edits should render unchanged.
